description: JavaScript code for managing order shipping information UI, including form validation, toggling edit/view modes, and dynamic display of form elements.

methods.name: showEdit
methods.description: Toggles visibility of edit and display elements for shipping info based on user interaction.

methods.name: restoreEditField
methods.description: Restores the original values in edit fields for shipping info.

methods.name: showShipByDate
methods.description: Shows or hides the shipping date input based on selected option.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Switches between view and edit modes for shipping information display.
